Implement the redesigned VPS deploy wizard as REAL code in /opt/nxeon-sandbox (an isolated sandbox clone of the Nxeon platform — do NOT touch /opt/nxeon or /opt/nxeon-staging). This app is LIVE-SERVING right now via systemd at https://flow.k9x4rq7wpz2ah6t.nxeon.cloud. Verify your work with `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` only — do NOT run `npm run build` and do NOT restart/touch systemd services (a coordinated final build+restart happens later, after all parallel redesign work lands, to avoid live asset-serving breakage from concurrent builds).

## What already exists (foundation + parallel work — read, don't recreate)
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/Stepper.tsx` — the new unified stepper, THIS IS THE COMPONENT YOU MUST USE. Signature:
  ```ts
  export function Stepper({ currentStep, steps, variant = "default", className = "" }: {
    currentStep: number;
    steps: (string | { label: string; description?: string })[];
    variant?: "default" | "muted";
    className?: string;
  })
  ```
  Circular badges → checkmark on completion, animated connector fill, `default` = brand gradient/glow (use this for the deploy wizard — it's a purchase flow), collapses to a dot-track + "Step N of M" below 768px.
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/primitives.tsx` — `Surface`, `Surface elevated`, `IconTile`, `Pill`, `StatusPill`, `StatCardV2`, `Gauge`, `BarMeter`.
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/icons.tsx` — new hand-drawn 24×24 stroke icons including `IconMonitor`, `IconLock`, `IconShield`, `IconArrowRight`, `IconRefresh`, `IconTerminal` and ~24 nav-oriented ones — check what's there before drawing anything new; only add new icons if the wizard genuinely needs a glyph none of these cover (e.g. a per-plan "rack" glyph, an OS logo-style glyph) — if so, add them to this same file, matching its exact stroke-width/style/24×24 viewBox convention, and pull exact path shapes from the wizard mockup below rather than inventing new ones.
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/app/globals.css` — new tokens `--color-pv-*` (→ `bg-pv-*`/`text-pv-*`/`border-pv-*`), `--radius-pv-*` (→ `rounded-pv-*`), `--font-pv-display`/`--font-pv-body` (Sora/Inter), and `.pv-surface`/`.pv-surface-elevated`/`.pv-ambient` component classes.
- Another agent may be concurrently touching `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` and `components/portal-v2/DashboardShellV2.tsx` for the nav/shell — do not touch those files; your wizard page renders INSIDE whatever shell exists, you don't need to know its internals.

## Read before writing any code
1. `/tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-wizard.html` — the approved mockup: VPS deploy flow collapsed from 5 real steps to 2 (Plan → Review & Pay), OS/Add-ons/Access shown as expandable-with-defaults sections, plan cards with custom SVG "rack" glyphs, live-updating price summary sidebar.
2. The FULL current `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` — this is a long, heavily-audited file with real incident-scarred logic (money races, promo/coupon reservation holds, wallet-split math, first-month-free eligibility). Read it completely before touching anything. Your job is to REVISUALIZE and RESTRUCTURE the steps (collapsing the flow per the mockup), NOT to touch or simplify any of the pricing/payment/reservation logic — every `orderQuote`/`walletSplit`/reservation/coupon call must survive exactly as-is, just presented through new step boundaries and new visual components.
3. `components/customer/PaymentStep.tsx`, `components/customer/WizardReassuranceCard.tsx`, `components/customer/PaymentTrustBar.tsx`, `components/customer/WizardStickyCart.tsx` — these carry real, honesty-constrained trust content (a money-back-guarantee claim was investigated and deliberately removed multiple times because no such policy is published — NEVER add one back, and never invent any new claim, guarantee, testimonial, countdown, or scarcity marker anywhere). Keep their real content, restyle their presentation to match the new surface/card language.

## What to build
Restructure `DeployWizard.tsx`'s rendered steps into the mockup's 2-screen shape:
- **Step 1 — Plan**: plan tier cards (new visual treatment, "rack" glyph per tier) + the term ladder shown together (so the displayed price is never the stale monthly rate while annual is pre-selected — check how `termMonths` defaults and make sure the card price updates live with the selected term). OS choice and Add-ons collapse into expandable sections with a plainly-stated default shown when collapsed (e.g. "Ubuntu 24.04 LTS — recommended" with a "Change" link that expands the picker) rather than being forced full screens.
- **Step 2 — Review & Pay**: order summary (using `StatCardV2`/`Surface` for the price breakdown) + the embedded `PaymentStep`. Every "Change" control on this step must reveal the relevant Step-1 section INLINE (scroll back up, expand it) — never a hard `setStep(0)` jump back to a blank Step 1.
- Use the new `<Stepper currentStep={...} steps={["Plan", "Review & Pay"]} variant="default" />` at the top in place of the current local `Stepper` function (delete the old local one once replaced).

## Constraints
- Do not change any pricing formula, any reservation/coupon/promo logic, or any Stripe/PaymentStep integration behavior — this is a visual/structural restack only.
- The sandbox's demo customer (`you@nxeon.local`) has a $100,000 fake wallet balance and Stripe is NOT configured (so card-required checkouts show "Card payments aren't set up yet — top up your wallet to deploy" — this is expected/correct sandbox behavior, don't try to "fix" it).
- No new external dependencies.

## When done
Report: exact files created/modified, confirmation `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes cleanly, and a plain list of every real feature/decision point from the OLD 5-step flow and which of the new 2 steps (and which expandable section within it) it now lives in — so a reviewer can confirm nothing real was silently dropped.

## Summary

I restructured the VPS deploy wizard in `/opt/nxeon-sandbox` from its 5-real-step flow into the approved 2-step (Plan → Review & Pay) design, using the new portal-v2 primitives, without touching any pricing/reservation/payment logic.

### Files modified

- **`components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx`** — the main restructure (step/section state, JSX layout, `ExpandRow` helper, `goToSection` navigation). No pricing formula, reservation/coupon/promo call, or Stripe/PayPal/Coinbase integration line was touched — verified via the diff.
- **`components/portal-v2/icons.tsx`** — added `IconRackStarter/Standard/Pro/Max` + `planRackGlyph(tierIndex)`, a new 120×52 "rack" glyph family for plan cards (per the task's guidance to add new glyphs here only when needed, matching this file's existing `currentColor` convention).
- **`components/customer/WizardStickyCart.tsx`**, **`PaymentTrustBar.tsx`**, **`WizardReassuranceCard.tsx`**, **`PaymentStep.tsx`** — presentation-only restyle to `pv-surface`/`pv-text-*`/`IconTile` tokens. All copy, claims, and the `moneyBackDays={30}` honesty gating (the real, admin-confirmed VPS policy already in the codebase) are byte-for-byte unchanged; no guarantee/testimonial/scarcity claim was added anywhere.

No new dependencies. No files created.

### Verification

`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes cleanly (exit 0), including a run with `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` deleted first to rule out stale incremental-cache false negatives.

### Where every old-flow feature now lives

**Step 1 — Plan** (`pv-surface` panel "Choose your plan"): plan tier cards (now with rack glyphs, `Pill` "Most popular", checkmark badge) + `TermLadder` shown together directly below, so price always reflects the selected term — unchanged `planMonthlyAtTerm`/`renewalQuote` math. The "Build a custom server" slider builder sits below, untouched.

**Step 1 — "Everything else, already set" panel**, each an `ExpandRow` (collapsed to a default summary, "Change" expands in place):
- *Server location* (multi-node only) — same node-picker grid.
- *Operating system* — same search/tabs (OS/Panels/Apps/Games), `AppLogo`/`GameCoverTile` grids, `VersionPickerModal`, plan-too-small warning, license note.
- *Add-ons* — same malware/backup/docker toggle cards + the nested "Advanced options" disclosure (dedicated IP, extra-disk slider, backup-tier retention cards).
- *Server name & access* — same hostname field/validation, root-password honesty note, SSH-key disclosure, admin "Deploy free" checkbox.

**Step 2 — Review & Pay**: the fallback (non-Stripe) breakdown is now wrapped in a `Surface` with two `StatCardV2` highlight tiles (Due today / Billing term) on top of the unchanged `Row`-based dl (promo code, coupon, tax, wallet toggle, wallet-after — all untouched). The embedded `PaymentStep` (Stripe/PayPal/Coinbase, order summary, trust cards) is unchanged except its `onEdit`/`onChangeTerm` and new inline "Change" links on Install/Location/Add-ons/Hostname now call `goToSection(...)`, which expands the right Step-1 section and scrolls to it — never a blank `setStep(0)`. The old duplicate inline `TermLadder` reveal (`showTermPicker`) was removed since Change now returns to the one, always-visible term ladder.

**Validation/gating**: `hostnameValid`, `planMeetsImage`, `installBlocker`, `accessBlocker`, `deployBlocker`, `canDeploy` are all preserved formulas; sections now auto-expand if they start blocking progress, and the Step-2 blocker banner gained a "Fix this →" link via `goToSection`.

**Known, intentional side effect**: `trackDeployStep`/`trackDeployError` funnel tracking now records 2 milestones ("Plan", "Review & Pay") instead of up to 6 — a direct, expected consequence of collapsing the flow, not a silent logic drop; flagged in-code and here for the reviewer.
